# netbox_interface_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a single interface template from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_interface_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "interface_template_id" {
  value = data.netbox_interface_template.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the interface template.

### Optional

- `device_type_id` (Number) The ID of the device type associated with the interface template.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the interface template.

### Read-Only

- `bridge_id` (Number) The ID of the bridge associated with the interface template.
- `channel_id` (Number) The channel id of the interface template.
- `channels` (Number) The channels of the interface template.
- `created` (String) The created of the interface template.
- `description` (String) A description of the interface template.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the interface template.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) The label of the interface template.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the interface template.
- `mgmt_only` (Boolean) The mgmt only of the interface template.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the interface template.
- `poe_mode` (String) The poe mode of the interface template.
- `poe_type` (String) The poe type of the interface template.
- `rf_role` (String) The rf role of the interface template.
- `type` (String) The type of the interface template.
